For Applicants Mr. Kps Gandhi, Advocate For Respondent /State Mr. Ashish Gupta, Panel Lawyer
Sb.: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Deepak Kumar Tiwari Order On Board 20/2/2023
1. Heard.

2.  This is the third application filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicants, who are apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.707/2004 registered at Police Station Korba (Police Chowki Urga) Korba (CG) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376, 109, 506, 34 of IPC.
3.

entities.text: Police Station Korba (Police Chowki Urga) Korba
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The first application of the applicants was dismissed vide order dated 10.12.2020 passed in MCRCA No.1333 of 2020 on the ground of maintainability reserving liberty in favour of the applicants to move before the Sessions Court.

The second bail application of the applicants was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file afresh, vide order dated 14.3.2022 passed in MCRCA No.863/2021.
4.
Case of the prosecution is that the complainant lodged an FIR on 20.7.2004 that main accused persons Jojwa @ Dulkha Dhimar has committed rape with the prosecutrix on the pretext of marriage.
The other accused persons had helped the main accused in commission of such act.
5. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants are innocent and have been falsely implicated in the case.
The applicants have not helped the other accused persons to commit the alleged offence.
He further submits that a proper procedure was not followed to declare the applicant as 'absconder'.

However, he submits that main accused Jojwa, Satyanarayan, Bega Yadav @ Shani and Indel Singh were convicted for the offence punishable under Sections 363/34, 366, 366 (Ka) of IPC and acquitted from the charges under Section 376 (1) and 120-B of IPC.

Therefore,
learned counsel prays for extending the benefit of Section 438 of Cr.P.C. to the applicants.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the bail application.
He submits that the present applicants assisted the main accused by providing him a motorcycle.

7. Having considered the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and the role attributed to the present applicants and further considering that the main accused have been acquitted from the charges under Section 376 of IPC, I am of the opinion that the present is a fit case to extend the benefit of Section 438 of Cr.P.C. to the applicants.
Certified copy as per rules.

Sd/-
